profile.faq.heading: Questions about these changes
profile.faq.updateEmailQ: What happens when I change my email address?
profile.faq.updateEmailA: We send a confirmation link to the new address and leave your account on the old one until you follow it. Once confirmed, the new address is what you sign in with, and every order confirmation, payment link and invoice goes there.
profile.faq.whenAppliesQ: When does the change take effect?
profile.faq.whenAppliesA: The moment the link is followed, and not before. Confirming an email address also signs you out on every device, because the address is your sign-in identity — sign back in with the new one.
profile.faq.historyQ: Do I lose my order history?
profile.faq.historyA: No. Your orders, invoices, saved addresses, scheduled orders and saved cards all stay exactly as they are. Changing a contact detail changes where we write to you and nothing else.
profile.faq.phoneCodeQ: Why does the number confirmation arrive by email?
profile.faq.phoneCodeA: This store has no text-message provider configured, so the link is sent to your email address instead. It proves the change came from you, which is what stops somebody else altering the number on your account.
profile.faq.ordersInFlightQ: What about an order that is already on its way?
profile.faq.ordersInFlightA: It is unaffected. An order keeps the delivery details captured when it was placed, so changing a number here does not redirect a delivery already in progress. Contact us if a delivery has to be redirected.
closeAccount.heading: Closing this account
closeAccount.description: Two different things, and it is worth knowing which one you want.
closeAccount.deactivateBody: Stops the account being used. You are signed out everywhere and nobody can sign back in. Nothing is deleted, and we can reopen it if you ask.
closeAccount.deleteBody: Erases the personal information we hold about you, permanently. Some records survive it: an invoice has to be kept for as long as tax law requires, so a deletion separates you from those records rather than destroying them.
closeAccount.deleteWhere: Ask for a deletion from the Your data panel above, which shows what is kept and tracks the request.
closeAccount.confirmDescription: Here is what closing it does.
closeAccount.impactUnavailable: We could not check what this affects. Closing the account still works, and anything scheduled is stopped safely.
closeAccount.willPauseSchedules_one: One scheduled order will be paused. Nothing further will be charged for it.
closeAccount.willPauseSchedules_other: {{count}} scheduled orders will be paused. Nothing further will be charged for them.
closeAccount.willWithdrawAutoPay: Your authority for us to charge a card automatically will be withdrawn.
closeAccount.unpaidOrdersRemain_one: One order is still unpaid. Closing the account does not cancel it, and the amount is still owed.
closeAccount.unpaidOrdersRemain_other: {{count}} orders are still unpaid. Closing the account does not cancel them, and the amounts are still owed.
closeAccount.historyIsKept: Your order history and invoices are kept, because tax law requires them to be.
closeAccount.reopenBySupport: We will email {{email}} to confirm. To reopen the account afterwards, write to us from that address.
closeAccount.couldNotClose: The account could not be closed. Check your password and try again.
